messages:
Kai Chen: Heads-up — prepping schema cutover for user_events tomorrow 02:00 UTC. I sketched a short checkpoint + rollback plan. Need ops + release sign-off before we pin the deploy window.
Maya Patel: thanks Kai. can you paste the exact holdpoint checks? curious about lock thresholds and read QPS impact.
Kai Chen: condensed plan below. quick notes: small DDL (add nullable col), online-apply via chunked ALTER + checkpoint rows processed. 2 holdpoints: 20% and 60% rows. abort conditions: >120s table lock OR replica lag > 45s OR CPU > 85% for >3min. fallback: pin to previous read model + mark write-only cutover.
Samir R: sounds reasonable. how are we doing the rows checkpointing?
Kai Chen: we use the cutover table and deployed worker that marks last_applied_id. pseudo: ```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE user_events ADD COLUMN device_version text;
-- background job copies in batches
UPDATE migration_checkpoints SET last_applied = $batch_end WHERE name = 'user_events_v2';
COMMIT;
```
Kai Chen: background copier uses chunk_size=10k, parallel=3. staging run: 1.2M rows copied in ~14m with avg lock spikes ~40s.
deploy-bot: deploybot: 🟢 Preflight checks passed for release/2026.03. Cutover job verified in staging: copier v1.4, metrics ok.
Maya Patel: good. what's our rollback hatch if we see sustained lock >120s? do we have an escape to stop and roll back a partially-applied change?
Kai Chen: rollback plan: pause incoming writes at the service layer (feature-flag writes to read-only queue), drain the copier, and run reversal job to null-out new column for rows after last_good_id. If we can't pause writes fast enough, we route writes to fallback DB replica (read-only) and surge throttle.
Samir R: who is on-call at the 02:00 window? need a primary + backup.
Maya Patel: I'll be primary for infra checks, @Samir you can be DB lead? Kai you'll own the migration job. ops-bot: rota note added: Maya (primary), Samir (secondary), Kai (migration owner). :white_check_mark:
Kai Chen: added gating in rollout: deployer will pause at holdpoint 1 and post status. to continue, release lead must post `:thumbsup:` in thread. if no ack in 6m, auto-rollback.
Maya Patel: ack. please add exact rollback commands to runbook.
Kai Chen: added runbook snippet below. short commands for rollback: ```bash
# stop worker
kubectl scale deploy copier --replicas=0 -n prod
# mark abort
psql -c "UPDATE migration_checkpoints SET aborted=true WHERE name='user_events_v2';"
# re-enable writes
curl -X POST https://release-gate.internal/feature-flag -d '{"user_events_write":true}'
```
deploy-bot: deploybot: ⚠️ Note: DB admin approval required for schema changes to prod. Please acknowledge by adding reaction or posting "db-ack".
Samir R: db-ack. I've approved in the DB approval tool. Will monitor locks and lag during cutover.
Maya Patel: +1. Also adding a small rate-limit rule to API gateway during the first 30m to smooth load: spike-protection=100r/s per region.
Kai Chen: perfect. final checklist: preflight (20:00 UTC), DB approval (01:00 UTC), feature-flag ready, on-call confirmed. will pin deploy window at 02:00–02:30 UTC.
Maya Patel: I'm good with that. Samir?
Samir R: good. I'll watch replicas and be ready to trigger rollback if ops-bot alerts on lag or lock threshold.
Kai Chen: thanks all. leaving final note: if anything looks off, post here and add `rollback` to trigger the emergency script. otherwise we'll proceed. :rocket:
